Owned derive patches remain 6/6 lines and 8/8 regions; reflection patches remain 126/128 lines and 347/352 regions. The 601-row native corpus and seven exact approved historical transitions preserve every fixture/native byte and all 97 sampled native-positive loader gaps, including the old 19.
